title: A renewed push to ban seclusion, reduce restraint in Michigan schools
summary_en: Michigan students were secluded or restrained nearly 18,000 times during the 2024-2025 school year. Advocates say more staff training and an emphasis on prevention would help students.
author: Isabel Lohman
title_cn: A renewed push to ban seclusion, reduce restraint in Michigan schools

title: Michigan universities make secret decisions; some lawmakers want change
summary_en: A 1999 Michigan Supreme Court ruling has allowed publicly funded universities to make most decisions behind closed doors, say those trying to change the situation.
author: Kim Kozlowski
title_cn: Michigan universities make secret decisions; some lawmakers want change
